name: Acceptance voice
description: The acceptance run's fixture voice: one of MOSS Voice's providers, it speaks any text as a short generated tone (pcm16-24k) and writes down push-to-talk's recording (pcm16-16k) as words that say how many bytes reached it, with no key and no network, so a run can see a bot's reply reach MOSS Voice's player as speech and the avatar's mouth move, and the talk button's recording reach the voice whole.
